2004.why: It drew about 4 times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about brakes. 2004 is one of the weaker years of a model that usually draws about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car.
2004.pln: about 4 times the average car's complaints
td: Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
